notes: NOT DISCLOSED: Century Communities does not report a count of completed/finished unsold (spec) homes or total spec homes in any SEC filing or company IR material checked (2019 Q1 to 2026 Q3). Checks: (1) Q3 2026 8-K EX-99.1 has no spec/finished/completed/unsold/under-construction wording; it reports deliveries of 2,442 homes in Q3 2026 ('Deliveries totaled 2,442 homes.') and 1,106 homes in backlog at 9/30/2026. (2) EDGAR full-text search on CIK 1576940, 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-10, found 0 hits for 'finished spec', 'completed and unsold', 'finished homes', 'spec inventory', 'homes in inventory'. 'Spec homes' hits are 10-K/10-Q risk-factor wording ('Because we carry a significant number of spec homes, adverse conditions could require rapid price reductions...'). (3) The 10-Q inventory note (e.g., 9/30/2026, R10.htm) gives only dollars: 'Homes under construction' $1,554,828K at 9/30/2026 and $1,213,810K at 12/31/2025, with no unit count, model-home, or completed/unsold split. (4) The IR-hosted investor presentations for Q3 2025 and Q3 2026 (q4cdn) say Century is '100% spec' and that most deliveries are spec builds, but give no finished-spec count. (5) The only company qualitative statement found is in the Q3 2022 8-K EX-99.1 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1576940/000157694022000083/ccs-20221026xex99_1.htm), where the co-CEO says '...our completed homes across our 45 plus markets are still at low levels.' It gives no number. Caveats: the phrase 'completed homes' also appears in the Q1 and Q2 2023 10-Qs and some 10-Ks, but WebFetch truncates those 10-Qs at about 32K characters (before MD&A), so the context was not read. Full-text search rules out the counted phrasings above. Counts such as '44 completed and unsold homes' (Q2 2022) and 'less than three finished specs per community' (Q1 2026) appear only in third-party earnings-call transcripts and summaries, so they are excluded. Quarterly delivery counts are in each 8-K EX-99.1 but were not tabulated because no spec metric exists to pair them with.
